name: Fogo Fátuo: Live Art Performance
description: Experience "art in motion" with an afternoon dedicated to performance art, featuring Bombos de Lavacolhos and a selection of songs by Lina Lapelytė.
longDescription:
"Fogo Fátuo: Live Art Performance" is an afternoon event at the Galeria Municipal do Porto dedicated to live art. The performance features the Bombos de Lavacolhos, a traditional Portuguese percussion group, alongside a selection of songs composed by Lithuanian artist Lina Lapelytė. The event aims to present a dynamic interplay between traditional sound and contemporary artistic expression within a gallery setting.

Visitors will experience a performance that blends musical elements with live artistic presentation. The event is scheduled for an afternoon slot, offering a focused engagement with the art. The Galeria Municipal do Porto provides a contemporary exhibition space for this type of artistic presentation.

Admission to "Fogo Fátuo" is free. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance of the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F). The venue is generally accessible.
